title: Three Men on the Road (Young Lady Not Including)
overview: A promotional short film from 1935 produced by the Zlín-based FAB studio. In this film, Vlasta Burian (playing himself) recommends Baťa tires; other actors do the same. The cast also includes Čeněk Šlégl (a motorcycle police officer), Hana Vítová (a young woman with a bicycle), and Josef Maleček. Burian delivers these lines: "I cast my old gear aside, for here are Baťa tires. With them, everyone is master of their machine—be it a young lady, a police officer, Maleček, or even Vlasta Burian. Thanks to their quality and low price, they always lead the way safely—that’s what Baťa tires are all about!"
